title: Explore and Learn
motivation: Discover a domain of interest, build foundational knowledge, and develop initial capabilities through research and exploration.

goals.title: Identify learning domain
goals.description: Work with the user to define the domain, or research broadly to discover interesting topics. Build initial knowledge in the collective knowledge tree.

outcomes: At least one L2 node exists in the knowledge tree with foundational domain knowledge

checks.condition: Has at least one L2 node registered

title: Operating Rhythm
motivation: Keep the shared queue plannable and honest: a periodic sprint-planning pass over the world and agent queues so priorities stay ordered, routing stays live, duplicates get consolidated, and every agent knows its next few goals. Never completes by design -- it is the recurring container for queue governance, the world-scope sibling of the agent seed's Maintain Agent Health.

goals.title: Sprint planning: backlog, priorities, per-agent plan
goals.description: Invoke Skill(sprint-planning) in STANDARD mode (never --ultra from a recurring firing) and follow its phases end-to-end: /backlog-report plus priority dashboard data, fleet-vantage directive check (one goal-selector select per live agent), bounded hygiene lanes (duplicates, routing, priority mismatches, recurring health, reclaim lanes Q/P/B, zombie aspirations), verified apply through canonical scripts with a session-scratch write ledger, then publish: sprint plan posted to the decisions board with top 2-3 priorities per agent for the next few days, idle-vs-overloaded rebalancing, stale lanes parked or retired, and only genuine human decisions escalated. A plan that changes no queue state is a report, not a plan -- take at least one concrete queue action or record an explicit no-change rationale.

outcomes: Sprint plan posted to the decisions board with per-agent priorities
At least one concrete queue action taken (re-route, re-prioritize, consolidate, park) or an explicit no-change rationale recorded
preconditions: World queue holds at least 10 non-terminal goals across aspirations (a smaller queue does not need a sprint pass yet)

goals.title: Framework self-update check: adopt the newest staging release
goals.description:
Adopt the newest framework release from the staging Mind, inside THIS Mind's own idle window. There is no one-shot executor script or skill for this (measured 2026-08-25 across four surfaces: .claude/skills/, a repo-wide grep for pull-promotion, world/forged-skills.yaml, and retrieval -- all negative). The protocol IS the executor: follow core/config/conventions/pull-promotion.md end to end (load-conventions.sh pull-promotion), C1 through C7, in STANDARD mode -- never a bulk `git pull`.

THE PULL IS A RECONCILE, NOT A MIRROR (C2). Run promotion-preflight.sh with source/target swapped for the pull direction; on a blocked --plan verdict run promotion-plan-triage.sh and record a decision. A downstream Mind self-evolves its own framework, so it can LEAD staging on individual files -- a blind mirror silently deletes those. Back-port target-ahead files UP before adopting, or discard them explicitly with a recorded reason. Never adopt past an exit-2 without resolving it (promotion-cycle.md; 2026-06-24: ZDS led staging on 18 files).

A tag is the only adoptable unit (C1). Read the RELEASES.json entry's `breaking` and `min_source` to gate adoption, `upgrade_recipe`/`rollback_recipe` for the apply/revert legs, and `cross_world` for C7. Do not invent parallel metadata. After adopting, run the suite and restart the daemon per the convention's own steps -- an adopted release that was never exercised is not adopted, it is staged.

IF NOTHING IS NEWER than the installed tag, close ROUTINE with the two tags named. A no-op run IS the expected steady state and is a successful run, not a wasted one.

INTERVAL RATIONALE (decided 2026-08-25, g-360-03 -- recorded here per guard-1527 so a future run does not re-derive it): 72h, the slow end of the 24h-72h band the filing suggested. Each run is a heavyweight reconcile (drift gate + back-port decisions + full suite + daemon restart), and staging releases are not daily, so a 24h cadence would spend most firings proving nothing changed while sitting on the loop's critical path. 72h bounds framework staleness to ~3 days. Raise the cadence only if a measured release rate justifies it.

outcomes: Either a newer release tag is ADOPTED (reconciled per pull-promotion.md, suite run, daemon restarted) or the run records that the installed tag is already newest, naming both tags
Any target-ahead file the drift gate flagged is back-ported upstream or explicitly discarded with a recorded reason -- never silently overwritten
preconditions: This deployment is NOT the dev origin: `bash core/scripts/env-read.sh value ENVIRONMENT_ID` (subcommand is `value`, not `get`) returns a non-empty id that is NOT `ayoai-mind`, and core/config/environments/<that-id>.yaml exists. Dev never pulls from staging (promotion-cycle.md). FAIL-CLOSED: an empty, unreadable, or unregistered id SKIPS the run -- a Mind that cannot identify itself must not adopt a framework release.

title: Memory Hygiene: retirement, dedup, and a live usefulness signal
motivation: The knowledge stores (reasoning bank, guardrails) only compound if three loops run forever: dead entries get RETIRED (measured on the origin deployment: +100 entries/day fleet-wide with retirement slates produced but never consumed), near-duplicates get MERGED into strengthened survivors (write-time similarity warns exist; nothing consolidates after the fact), and the usefulness signal stays LIVE (measured: 78% of entries never marked helpful, single-digit signal events/day against triple-digit births — under any ranking formula an unsignaled corpus is indistinguishable noise). Never completes by design: it is the recurring container for memory governance, the store-side sibling of Operating Rhythm's queue governance.

goals.title: Store retirement pass: consume the scar-tissue slate, apply with evidence
goals.description: Run the scar-tissue retirement lane end-to-end, not just the measurement: (1) run core/scripts/scar-tissue-check.py (or read its latest slate) for the guardrail + reasoning-bank retirement candidates; (2) for each candidate, verify the evidence gate — never retire on a missing-file signal or utilization zeros alone (a passive always-on rail reads zero by design); require a superseding entry, a measured no-regression, or a falsified premise; (3) apply the survivors deliberately via core/scripts/bulk-retire-dead-entries.py --apply (it is proposal-only by design — this goal IS the deliberate consumer it was built to wait for); (4) record the active:retired ratio before/after in the goal outcome so the trend is auditable. Subtraction is learning (learning-philosophy rule 5): a session that only removes real carrying cost has not under-produced.

outcomes: Retirement slate reviewed with an explicit per-candidate verdict (retired / kept-with-reason)
Applied retirements went through the sanctioned bulk/single retire scripts, never direct store edits
active:retired ratio recorded before and after in the outcome
preconditions: Store holds at least 500 active entries (below that, retirement pressure is premature)

goals.title: Near-duplicate consolidation pass: merge one dense cluster into strengthened survivors
goals.description: Pick the single densest category in guardrails or the reasoning bank (by active-entry count) and consolidate its near-duplicates: (1) rank pairwise similarity within the category (the write-time store-dupe similarity machinery is the reference implementation — reuse its tokenizer, never invent a second); (2) for each high-similarity cluster, choose the strongest survivor, fold any unique detail from the others into it (Edit via the sanctioned update scripts), increment the survivor's utilization.times_helpful (a duplicate attempt is evidence the lesson keeps being re-learned — that IS a usefulness signal), and retire the absorbed entries with a supersedes pointer; (3) record cluster count, entries absorbed, and the category's before/after count in the outcome. One category per firing, chosen by density — depth over breadth.

outcomes: At least one cluster consolidated (or an explicit no-clusters-above-threshold finding with the threshold and category named)
Every absorbed entry is retired with a supersedes reference, never deleted
Survivor entries carry the folded detail and a helpful-signal increment

goals.title: Usefulness-signal health check: prove positive feedback is still flowing
goals.description: The ranking, retirement, and consolidation loops all starve if the usefulness signal dies — and it dies silently (measured on the origin deployment: an intended backstop gate had fired 0 times in fleet history while its replacement ran unmeasured). Check the flow, not the machinery: (1) sum times_helpful + times_inferred_helpful across the guardrail and reasoning-bank stores and compare against the sum recorded at the last firing of this goal (store the sums in this goal's outcome each firing — the previous outcome IS the baseline); (2) a near-zero delta over the interval means the signal pipeline is starving: trace it stage by stage — goal-execution retrieval must write a retrieval-session manifest, the iteration-close repair helper must run the infer against it, and the increments must land in the store — and file the fix with the broken stage named; (3) also report the never-helpful fraction: if it is rising, the signal is losing ground to the birth rate even while flowing.

outcomes: Current helpful+inferred sums recorded in the outcome beside the prior firing's sums and the delta
A near-zero delta produced a stage-by-stage trace and a filed fix goal naming the starving stage
Never-helpful fraction reported with its direction of movement
